title: English background corpus for IDF estimation
notice: Synthetic general-language text written for this package. It stands in for the large background collection the paper computes idf over.
documents: The council has published its budget for the coming financial year. Spending on road maintenance rises by three percent, while the library service is held flat. A public consultation runs until the end of the month. Officials said the settlement from central government was lower than requested.

Rain is expected across most of the country on Thursday, turning heavier in the west during the afternoon. Temperatures will reach fourteen degrees on the coast and nine degrees inland. Winds will be light and variable. The weekend should be drier and brighter.

The home side won three goals to one after a second half in which they controlled possession almost completely. Their striker scored twice in eleven minutes. The visitors finished with ten men after a booking in the seventieth minute. The result moves the home side to fourth in the table.

Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil and add the pasta. While it cooks, heat the oil in a heavy frying pan and soften the onion and garlic for about eight minutes. Add the tomatoes and simmer until the sauce thickens. Drain the pasta, keeping a cup of the cooking water, and combine.

The new timetable takes effect on Sunday. Services between the two cities will run every twenty minutes during the day, up from every half hour. Three early morning trains have been withdrawn. The operator said the changes reflect passenger numbers recorded over the last two years.

Researchers followed some fourteen thousand adults for eleven years and found that those who walked at least thirty minutes a day had a measurably lower risk of heart disease. The effect held after adjusting for age, income and smoking. The authors caution that the study is observational and cannot establish cause.

The company reported revenue of one point two billion for the year, an increase of six percent. Operating profit fell slightly because of higher energy and wage costs. The board proposed an unchanged dividend. Shares were broadly flat in early trading.

The exhibition brings together some ninety works, many of them lent by private collections and rarely shown in public. It follows the artist's career from the early landscapes to the very late portraits. The gallery expects it to be the busiest show of its season. Tickets must be booked for a timed entry slot.

Farmers report that the harvest is running about two weeks late after a cold and wet spring. Yields are expected to be close to average, though quality varies considerably between regions. The price paid at the farm gate has fallen since last year. Several growers said the cost of fertiliser remains the main pressure on margins.

The court ruled that the regulator had exceeded its powers when it imposed the penalty and set the decision aside. It did not rule on whether the underlying conduct had breached the rules. The regulator said it was considering an appeal. The judgment is likely to affect several similar cases.

The university will open a new engineering building in September. It provides teaching space for around eight hundred students and laboratories for the materials and robotics groups. Roughly a third of the cost came from a private donation. The old workshops on the same site will be demolished next year.

Air quality in the city centre improved for the third consecutive year, according to figures published on Monday. Nitrogen dioxide levels fell by nine percent, though two monitoring stations still record readings above the legal limit. Officials credited the low-emission zone and the expansion of the bus fleet. Campaigners said progress remained too slow.

The concert opened with a short piece written for the ensemble two years ago and closed with a symphony that most of the audience had come to hear. The playing was precise and the strings in particular sounded confident. The hall was close to full. A recording will be broadcast next month.

A fire broke out in a warehouse on the industrial estate shortly after nine on Friday evening. Six units attended and the blaze was under control within three hours. Nobody was hurt. The cause is under investigation and the road remained closed overnight.

The software release adds support for two new file formats and rewrites the export module, which had been the source of most reported bugs. Users on the older version will be upgraded automatically over the next fortnight. The documentation has been reorganised. Developers said the next release will focus on performance.
